brief.headline: User frustration regarding feature monetization and subscription shifts
brief.happening: Users report that many previously free features are now locked behind a premium paywall. This has led to a steady trend of dissatisfaction, with 4 reviews in the last 12 months specifically citing the shift to a subscription model.
brief.where_to_look: The feature access logic within the premium subscription tier.
brief.action: Review the distribution of feature availability between free and premium tiers.
brief.reply: We hear your frustration regarding the recent changes to our feature availability. We understand that the shift to a subscription model is a significant change from your previous experience. If you would like to discuss this further, please reach out to our support team.

requests.request: Revert features previously included for free to free tier
requests.quote: used to be good back in the day, now almost every useful feature that used to be free is now paywalled and locked to premium. sad to see what one of my favorite editing …

actions.direction: Revert the specific features that were previously included in the free tier back to the free tier to address the 3 reviews requesting this change.
actions.outcome: Users will no longer report frustration regarding the loss of previously free functionality.
actions.check: The share of reviews mentioning feature paywalls should decrease relative to the total number of reviews.

brief.headline: User dissatisfaction regarding feature accessibility and pricing changes
brief.happening: Users report that previously free features are now locked behind a premium paywall. This feedback represents 18% of recent reviews with an average rating of 1.5 stars.
brief.where_to_look: The feature entitlement and subscription upgrade flow.
brief.action: Review the recent changes to feature availability for non-premium users.
brief.reply: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We understand your frustration regarding the changes to our feature availability and the transition of certain tools to our premium tier. We value your long-term support and invite you to contact our support team to discuss your experience further.

requests.request: Revert paywalled features to free access
requests.quote: used to be good back in the day, now almost every useful feature that used to be free is now paywalled and locked to premium. sad to see what one of my favorite editing …

actions.direction: Start with the most-asked change: revert paywalled features to free access (2 of 2 reviews).
actions.outcome: Fewer reviews raising this problem after the release that ships it.
actions.check: Watch this complaint's share of reviews in the next release on the "Did the fix work?" chart.

quotes.title: Terrible payment charge process

gists: Charged multiple times without notice; support refused cancellation.
Charged for years without confirmation; refund difficult to obtain.

brief.headline: Issues regarding billing transparency and cancellation difficulty
brief.happening: Users report being charged multiple times without notification and experiencing difficulty obtaining refunds or processing cancellations. These 2 reviews represent 18% of all recent reviews, with an average rating of 1.
brief.where_to_look: the subscription management and payment processing flow
brief.action: Review the communication logs for subscription renewal notifications and cancellation requests.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear about your experience with these charges. We want to ensure our billing process is clear and easy to manage. Please contact our support team so we can look into your account details and assist you directly.

requests.request: Send payment notifications and receipts for charges
requests.quote: … They have also failed to respond to the predatory pricing activities of refusing to send charge notifications (no receipts ever sent)

actions.direction: Implement automated payment notifications and receipts for all charges to address the 2 reviews requesting better billing transparency.
actions.outcome: Users will no longer report missing documentation for their transactions.
actions.check: The share of reviews mentioning missing receipts or notifications should drop to zero.
